title: Window-study reference trained with batch 8 (A0 training)
description: Batch-size check: the window-study reference with A0's original training (batch 8, learning-rate factor 0.7 after 10 flat epochs, early stop 25, at most 200 epochs). Seed 0 for all six people, compared with the batch-64 reference to decide the study's training (13 Nov 2026: batch 64 within 5 % for 4 of 6 people, median person +0.8 % MAE).
